newsitem.title: THAILAND: BMW sees strong 1996 profit and sales.
newsitem.headline: BMW sees strong 1996 profit and sales.

text.p: Bayerische Motoren Werke AG (BMW) chairman and chief executive officer, Bernd Pischetsrieder, said on Thursday he believed it was fair to expect the company to report a 10 percent profit growth and 4.0 percent increase in sales in 1996.
"Its a fair assessment," he told Reuters in an interview when asked if the company expected full year results to be in line with its six-month figures.
"I would forsee for the rest of the year it will be about the same," he said.
In July, the German car maker said the group's net profit surged nearly 10 percent in the first half of 1996 and that it expected higher unit sales for the year as a whole.
BMW's net profit in 1995 fell 0.7 percent to 692 million marks.
